categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet transaction caching and notification logic in `src/wallet/wallet.cpp` and `src/wallet/transaction.h`.
categories.rationale: Removes redundant cache invalidations and GUI status refreshes left over from previous architectural changes. Following PR #27286, balances are tracked via `m_txos` and `mapTxSpends` while `CWalletTx` caches only transaction-specific amounts, meaning "the cache invalidation recomputes the same values, and the notification makes the GUI refresh a status that has not changed" (PR description).
